title: Integrality of weighted multiplicity sums in [0, ∞]
statement: Let ι be a type, θ : ι → ℕ, w : ι → ℝ, t ∈ ℝ with t > 0 and m ∈ ℕ. Assume w(i) ≤ t for all i ∈ ι and Σ'_i θ(i)·ofReal(w(i)) = ofReal(m·t) in [0, ∞]. Then (i) m ≤ Σ'_i θ(i) in [0, ∞]; and (ii) for every i₀ ∈ ι and k ∈ ℕ such that θ(i) ≥ 1 for all i, θ(i₀) = k, w(i₀) = t and w(i) < t for all i ≠ i₀, one has k ≤ m, and if k < m then m + 1 ≤ Σ'_i θ(i).
lean_statement: ∀ (ι : Type) (θ : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 < t → (∀ i, w i ≤ t) → ∑' i, (θ i : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (w i) = ENNReal.ofReal ((m : ℝ) * t) → (m : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ∑' i, (θ i : ℝ≥0∞) ∧ ∀ (i₀ : ι) (k : ℕ), (∀ i, 1 ≤ θ i) → θ i₀ = k → w i₀ = t → (∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → w i < t) → k ≤ m ∧ (k < m → (m : ℝ≥0∞) + 1 ≤ ∑' i, (θ i : ℝ≥0∞))
